text:
rafael-fp&a: Heads-up — new guidance for recurring SaaS renewals and an expedited approval path for certain renewals starting today. Please read carefully before approving renewals. https://redwood.company/finance/saas-renewals :memo:

procurement-bot: POLICY UPDATE by @rafael-fp&a
- Auto-renewal cancellations: All auto-renewals > $3k/year must be reviewed 30 days before renewal date.
- Fast-pass renewals: Recurring vendors on the Approved SaaS List with annual cost <= $12k can use the Fast-Pass flow (no PO) if: 1) vendor on list, 2) no contract changes, 3) finance voucher attached.
- Changes to T&Cs or price increases require full PO + legal review regardless of amount.

nina-marketing: quick q — our design tool renewal is $9.5k and vendor is on the approved list. Do we still need a PO?

rafael-fp&a: @nina-marketing you can use the Fast-Pass. Please file `/procure renew` with the vendor invoice and tick "Fast-Pass" checkbox. Finance will validate the invoice and post a voucher within 48 hrs.

mira-sales: for enterprise seats that increase during renewal (we upsold mid-year), does that disqualify Fast-Pass?

procurement-bot: Reminder: Fast-Pass condition 2 = "no contract changes." Seat count changes that result in a new amendment are considered a contract change and require PO + legal.

cta: (system) scheduled reminder: renewals audit in 30 days.

cto-jess: Rafael — can we add a temporary pilot for renewals between $12k and $25k for teams with exec sign-off? Many infra tools fall in that band and slow renewals hurt velocity.

rafael-fp&a: @cto-jess we can pilot that for Q2 with a strict checklist: exec sign-off note, vendor on approved list for 12+ months, and finance review within 72 hrs. I'll open a pilot request form and share the link.

nina-marketing: thanks. Also can we get a one-page cheat sheet for managers handling renewals? Will save tickets.

rafael-fp&a: yes 1 — short cheat sheet and a Trello card template coming by EOD. Example copy for `/procure renew` description:

```
Vendor: CreativeCloud Co.
Annual amount: $9,500
Business owner: Nina Marketing
Justification: Design seats for product + growth; renewal date 2026-05-30
Approved vendor list: Yes (ID: SAAS-042)
Invoice: attached
```

procurement-bot: New workflow commands:
- `/procure renew` to start a renewal request
- `/procure fastpass` to flag an eligible renewal

mira-sales: Will forward to regional sales ops. Any GL guidance?

rafael-fp&a: Use GL-4301 for SaaS subscriptions. If it's a customer-facing product tool, tag `GL-4502` and add team note. We'll reclassify if needed.

procurement-bot: Policy version: 2026-03-25_saas_fastpass_v1. Archived prior policy at https://redwood.company/finance/policies/archive

nina-marketing: appreciated. One last thing 1 are we cancelling auto-renewals on our side or leaving them for Fast-Pass?

rafael-fp&a: Teams keep auto-renew enabled only if vendor is on approved list and you used Fast-Pass last cycle. Otherwise cancel and submit renewal 30 days prior.

cto-jess: Good balance. Please loop in Legal on the pilot timeline.

rafael-fp&a: Will do. If anyone has edge cases (multi-year prepaid contracts, international invoicing), DM me and I'll triage.

nina-marketing: copying to #marketing-ops. Thanks all :pray:
